closure_rules: Every role and parameter key from the operation entry occurs once. No undeclared key. Required known/effect minima are operation admission predicates, not permission to discard incomplete history.
KnownRef targets resolve to exact listed types. A driver extension uses a selected exact input/output contract; unknown critical payload grammars hold execution.
S3 typed_payload.reference_context explicitly binds all embedded references to that package/format; never infer context from the S1 artifact storage package.
No unresolved reference receives a stand-in UUID. Unknown S2 binding preserves evidence but blocks a newly issued scientific run.
Every returned effect boundary is per-command, independent of operation return state. Exceptions/crash after prepared intent retain possible effects until reconciled.
No coordinator may receive a valid LiveAdmission when a required owner decision/hold/validity or strict guarantee is unresolved.
grammar_rules: All parameter grammar fields required/closed. Native driver parameters select one exact declared contract with a supplied pure decoder; no arbitrary dictionary fallback.
Only nonnegative finite quantities in capacity/charge fields, positive canonical Index text for limits, start<=end for byte ranges, valid UTC instants/uncertainties, and exact source-selector bounds.

result_laws: Rejected requires issues; may retain immutable evidence and effect uncertainty. It must not contain an executable LiveAdmission.

native_identity_projection.encoding: strict base64 of compact UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=false, no normalization, prefixed s3-incarnation-key-v1:
native_identity_projection.output: S1 native_id derived registry key, with authority/namespace retained and source.basis=derived; raw descriptor/bridge receipt pinned
native_identity_projection.limits: Driver must explicitly support this bridge and use raw native coordinates for provider calls. Unknown incarnation requires a separate positively established literal-unique identity rule, not empty substitution.

owner_correlation_law: correlation identifies the stable reservation/authority subject binding; request_occurrence identifies one immutable reserve/reconcile/renew/settle/release/authorize request. Same request occurrence plus changed parameters conflicts. Renewal/settlement uses a new request occurrence and expected revision under the same unchanged subject binding. Reconcile names the exact lost request occurrence; no second hold or renewal inferred.
transmission_law: Command C is immutable exact intended effect; D is an allocated forwarding occurrence with its own durable issue transaction and per-boundary observation. Never update an old D with newly learned receipt/time. Later evidence references it. Recovery looks up the exact transaction before deciding whether another D is permitted. A new D/owner epoch may reuse C only with explicit current admission and still-valid native single-effect guarantee; no changed payload/key/recipient/required guarantee under C.
scientific_binding_law: Scientific-run purpose or an otherwise applicable S2 intent requires exactly one established run binding and actual matching conditions before issue. A fixed, explicitly non-scientific preparation/probe commission can use a positively justified NA scientific binding, while retaining all actual native effects, costs/exposure and S2 contamination/history consequences. Purpose cannot be relabeled after results or used to override visible C01 triggers.
external_origin_recovery_law: The one-parent restart profile accepts an established s1.attempt or an adequate known s3.native_subject as predecessor. Unknown original S1 A/R stays unresolved; S3 driver support, actual native state/stop/ownership and scientific policy remain required. Exact S1 recovery projection is unavailable without its real predecessor/successor attempt identities; do not fabricate them. Multi-parent continuation uses a separately registered typed contract, not this one-parent profile.
serialization_inheritance: Revision3 is complete common schema data plus explicit operational contracts here; inherited semantics are the exact pinned revision1/revision2 sources. Record/format/core operation revisions are3. Existing S1/S2 remain revision1; the unchanged incarnation-key algorithm retains its explicitly pinned version2 procedure. No implicit semver widening.
namespace_delta_law: Runtime RecordDelta partitions new S3 records, owned S1 native additions and owned S2 scientific additions. They never share a serialized records array. Before append/capture commit, freeze owned additions in their own exact formats and resolve bridge/pin context into immutable PinnedViews; only CommitDelta enters the durable journal. Failure leaves staging/orphan/uncertain commit evidence, not a published cursor.

lexical_rules.ID: lowercase UUIDv4; source/native IDs remain separate scoped values
lexical_rules.String: Unicode scalar sequence without normalization; unknown native encoding remains bytes
lexical_rules.Code: QName; selecting a code does not install its meaning

review_refinements.FR01: plan returns a staged immutable command. Caller persists admission_occurrence and transmission_occurrence before corresponding effectful calls. Admission plan/owner IDs are durably recorded before first owner RPC. Same ID with changed binding conflicts; lost reply resumes/reconciles the same occurrence, never silently allocates a new one.
review_refinements.FR02: StateComponent.restore_source identifies captured payload or native handle; availability is separately assessed for the actual loader/cutoff/rights. Identity, readable bytes and actual loading do not imply one another. S1 projection records unavailable raw bytes as unknown/NA and reports loss; it cannot disguise provider attestations as state bytes.
review_refinements.FR03: command.admission is the construction-time assessment, possibly unresolved. Later immutable admission assessments/owner receipts reference the command and admission occurrence; current authority comes from live checked owner capabilities, never mutation of C or deserialization of old grants.
review_refinements.FR04: commit_capture transaction key equals batch_occurrence; prepare_issue transaction key equals D. A lost transaction ACK is queried by original key and exact binding before cursor advance/new forwarding. Only the first definitely committed D claim receives a live one-time permit; replay, lookup, restart and uncertain commits receive none. A negative native query permits retry only with established closure of old acceptance paths or valid receiver deduplication covering all still-eligible arrivals.
review_refinements.FR05: Initial local SQLite rollback journal plus immutable artifact store is qualified only for cooperative same-host processes and tested process crashes. No shared/network path, hostile writer, power-loss, distributed or external native enforcement claim.
review_refinements.FR06: Retrospective v2 archives remain preservation fixtures. Independently specified new positive S2-bound executions and receiver-side failure oracles are mandatory before execution support can pass; never fabricate historical identities/bindings.
review_refinements.FR07: New tests use test_audit_execution_*.py to match current discovery; gate must prove every mandatory new case was collected and executed without skips.
review_refinements.FR08: Opaque runtime credentials can use owner-approved native transport, but never audit serialization/logging. Restricted raw diagnostics stay restricted or explicitly uncaptured; redacted diagnostics are derived evidence, never substituted original bytes.
review_refinements.FR09: S3 reads pinned S1/S2 packages; existing S1/S2 readers are not expanded to S3 dialect. Return frozen S1 evidence and existing S2 receipts under explicit bridges; unsupported rich projection keeps loss/withheld claims.
review_refinements.FR10: Release receipts separate offline framework conformance, recorded-data parity, actual host matrix and native backend qualification. Skips/not-run/unsupported never become native success.

normalization_rules: V3-only native S3 decoding initially. Prior S3 candidate versions can be raw-preserved or explicitly converted into new IDs with losses; no silent promotion of missing bindings/authority/availability.

V2 captured-state availability maps to V3 restore_source=captured_payload; actual V3 availability remains unresolved unless separately established. Do not infer available=true from a known snapshot reference.
Explicit operator-supplied non-scientific purposes cannot waive an otherwise visible scientific requirement; actual costs/exposure/history remain accounted.
Observed native handles/reference descriptors may support owner-verified restoration without central raw bytes, only under their exact loader/identity/validity/rights contracts.

A repeated admit or issue call with original IDs must reconcile existing intent/result. New D under unresolved C is held unless explicit valid receiver idempotency/no-effect evidence and policy permit forwarding.
forwarding_claim_law: prepare_issue atomically records the original D intent and its one-time local forwarding claim. Only the first definitely committed claim may receive an issuer-held OpaqueIssuePermit, bound to C/D/binding/epoch and consumed by the guarded driver boundary. Same-key replay, transaction lookup, lost/uncertain commit or process restart never mints a fresh permit for D. A returned historical token has runtime_permit=None. Field copies/JSON cannot forge the permit. Crash after claim and before actual send conservatively retains possible effects until scoped reconciliation. This controls coordinator forwarding, not provider duplicate execution or native exactly-once.
native_absence_law: A negative lookup may establish absence only at its exact query cutoff. A new potentially duplicate forwarding additionally requires actual no_late_acceptance evidence closing earlier in-flight acceptance paths, or an actual single-effect receiver contract covering all still-eligible arrivals/retention windows. Empty/eventually consistent listing, sender timeout or local lease expiry provides neither. Receiver fencing/tombstone/expired-authorization evidence must be scoped and positively established; otherwise hold the new effect and retain possible work/charges/exposure.
